fact: At the March 2024 closing of the Italy-funded GOVNET Plus project, INAGE reported 88 institutions connected to GOVNET in 32 districts, and the minister said GOVNET is present in 963 public institutions covering 141 districts.
title: AICS and Mozambique: District-level extension of the Government's digital network GovNet (GovNet Plus)
publisher: Agenzia Italiana per la Cooperazione allo Sviluppo (AICS), Maputo
